summary: United Microelectronics Corporation filed a routine Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, attaching Exhibit 99.1, a monthly Taiwan-style insider shareholding disclosure for August 2026. The filing reports trading, pledges, and release of pledges of UMC common shares by directors, executive officers, and 10% shareholders; both the trading and pledge tables show no changes between July 31, 2026 and August 31, 2026. No stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or transaction mechanics are stated. This is an ordinary foreign private issuer current report, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
